Supporting information needed

Dear Ms. Gupta,
Thank you for submitting your research grant application. The committee
is ready to finalize our review, but a few items in the proposed budget
need clarification to ensure accurate evaluation:
• For equipment, provide a brief justification and confirmation that the
items are allowed under the grant's guidelines.
• For contracted services, please identify the intended vendor (or note
"to be determined") and provide the basis for the cost estimate.
Please upload the revised budget via the grant portal by November 18.
I have attached sample budget scenarios that you may use as examples
when making your calculations. Please also verify your current
enrollment by uploading a PDF of your course schedule. I'm happy to
discuss any questions by phone or email. Thank you for your prompt
attention.
Regards,
Michael Anderson
Office of Sponsored Programs
